ownerReported.finding: Not an invariant violation, and the walk does not find it: the command bar filter (input.ocu-command-bar-filter) on agent/definitions/edit has the accessible name Filter rows as Chrome computes it, is 220px wide and does not overflow. The walk records no name, min-width or overflow entry for it at either width.

Resolved by Story 5.14. At 1280 px the walk records no min-width or overflow entry for the composer or ocu-panel-send (its 72px floor is read from --ocu-panel-send-width); the only app-panel entries at 1280 are the resize handle, 4px past aside.ocu-panel by its declared left: -4px hit area.

Not reproduced on this tree, so no entry carries the tag. Measured on the fresh slot-B throwaway: at 720 px, opened directly and after a 1440 to 720 resize, document scrollWidth equals clientWidth (720), app-panel spans 400 to 720 and .ocu-shell-content 48 to 400. The walk finds no page-level horizontal scroll at 720; its only agent-panel entry at 720 is the resize handle, 4px past aside.ocu-panel, which it also finds at 1280.
